page.notes: The strip at the far left (margin text of the neighbouring page) is the edge of the other page and is left out. The diagram is an outline: the leftmost label "Ministerii Christus obiit" is level 1; brace levels were read from the drawing. Hyphens inside diagram boxes are line-break hyphens as printed. "Iohannis cap. II." is printed in Roman numerals as shown. Italic status of some diagram labels (Alienis, Discipulis, Insidiantibus) was uncertain and left roman. Long s is plain s; v/u and i/j normalised as instructed.
